name: Docket
description: Ruled docket lines — a full measure over a short one, the short line lengthening on alternate rows.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; top: 26%; width: 80%; height: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; top: 54%; width: 48%; height: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { :after { width: 68%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
